issues.reason: The existential section states it outright — a definite description is encoded as a typed individual sk_<class>_<n> plus its Member atom, and the bare class symbol is reserved for a non-specific / generic object, "never for a specific definite individual".
The selling does not take place inside the bottles, so (Location sk_sell_1 glass_bottle) is false; the PP names the container the goods are sold in and fails the where-test that licenses Location.

gaps_confirmed: container / packaging PPs ("sold in glass bottles", "packed in crates") — no named role fits and nothing states whether the container attaches to the event or to the goods; the preposition-named oblique is the only landing spot, though its stated trigger is "about / directed at"
new_gaps: definite MASS reference ("the milk", "the water") — the definite-to-witness rule is illustrated only with count nouns, so whether a mass definite mints a witness or stays the mass constant is unstated
repair_summary: Minted the definite referent as sk_milk_1 with its (Member sk_milk_1 milk) typing and used it as the Theme filler. Replaced the false (Location sk_sell_1 glass_bottle) with the preposition-named oblique (In sk_sell_1 glass_bottle), the preposition actually used.
